scope: source review and bounded local TestClient tests

findings.title: Document reads ignore current tenant membership
findings.expected: Current tenant membership is required for owners and shared recipients (app/README.md).
findings.observed: After authorized directory migration to south, both owner and live-share recipient received HTTP 200 and the complete north document.
reproduction: Run python evidence/reproduce.py against evidence/app.before.py restored as app/app.py in an isolated workspace copy.
Observe owner_migration and recipient_migration: baseline 200; after migration 200 with document_returned=true.
preconditions: Authenticated owner or live-share recipient subsequently moves away from the document tenant.
uncertainty: Demonstrated only against local synthetic instances; deployment and real data impact were not assessed.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant confidentiality breach of previously owned/shared documents; no new write capability demonstrated.
findings.remediation: Applied tenant comparison before ownership/share evaluation; both paths retested as 404.

findings.title: Expired shares continue granting document access
findings.expected: Shares grant access only while unrevoked and before expires_at (app/README.md).
findings.observed: An initially valid persisted share was expired through authorized fixture setup; recipient still received HTTP 200 and the complete document.
reproduction: Run python evidence/reproduce.py against the preserved original source in an isolated workspace copy.
Observe expiry: baseline 200; after expiry 200 with document_returned=true.
preconditions: Authenticated same-tenant recipient has a previously valid, now expired, unrevoked share.
uncertainty: Demonstrated only against local synthetic instances; deployment and real data impact were not assessed.
findings.impact: Confidentiality exposure continues beyond the owner-selected access window.
findings.remediation: Applied strict current-time comparison in share read authorization; expired access retested as 404 while owner and live shares remain valid.

limitations: No deployment, concurrency, load, or broad malformed-input testing
